content:
rachel: Quick postmortem note: a handful of tenants reported quiet quality regressions yesterday. Traced it to routing falling back from v2 -> v1 during quota enforcement.
tom: Any evidence whether it was precedence or header mismatch?
igor: Found a curious pattern: some requests had X-Client-Variant set to "v2" but our header normalizer was lowercasing and stripping the hyphen in one codepath, turning it into an unrecognized key. Router then defaulted to sticky behavior and matched v1.
emily: Wait, so not strictly RATE_CAP? Looks like two issues converged: quota enforcement + header parity bug.
igor: Exactly. Logs: 
```
[2025-04-11T20:11:02Z] req=Q9A route=org/zephyr incoming_headers={xclientvariant:v2, authorization:***} normalized_headers={x_client_variant:unknown}
[2025-04-11T20:11:02Z] decision=sticky_match -> selected=org/zephyr:v1
```
rachel: Oof. That explains why tenants saw silent fallbacks with no clear quota spike in their dashboards.
tom: Telemetry gap: we don't currently emit a metric when header normalization causes unknown variant lookup. We only emit on explicit fallback_reason=RATE_CAP, so this class of failures is invisible.
emily: Proposal: emit `route.fallback` events for any fallback path with tags {from_variant, to_variant, reason=(rate_cap|header_norm|sticky)}, and set low-cardinality values. Sample traces at 1/200 for perf.
igor: I'll fix the normalizer to preserve hyphenated header keys in the router path and add an audit log when header parity changes outcome. Add unit tests.
rachel: Console UX: add a tiny note under route traffic: "Fallback count (last 1h)" with a dropdown to filter by reason. For header_norm reasons show a tooltip: "header mismatch detected - check client SDK or proxy that may rewrite headers."
tom: Also tie the fallback metric to quota dashboards so teams can see if fallbacks correlate with quota bursts. If header_norm is non-zero but rate_cap is zero, that's a clear signal.
emily: Add a transient alert rule: if header_norm_fallbacks > 10 in 5m then page infra on-call to investigate potential gateway/proxy bug.
igor: Action items: 1) igor -> normalizer patch + tests (ETA: today). 2) emily -> metric schema + sampling plan + alert (ETA: tomorrow). 3) rachel -> console mock + tooltip copy (ETA: tomorrow AM). 4) tom -> saved query for support to find tickets mentioning "v2 degraded" (ETA: today).
telemetry-bot: Registered metric: route.fallback (tags: from,to,reason,tenant). Sampling: event_count + sampled_traces(0.5%).
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: igor/header-preserve-fix -> canary in prod-1 at 2025-04-12T04:00:00Z.
rachel: After canary, run a small synthetic that sends malformed header variants through common gateways to validate behavior.
emily: I'll add the synthetic and wire the results into the canary dashboard.
igor: Will include extra logs for 1% of canary requests so we can verify header normalization behavior without spamming production.
tom: Nice. Also consider adding an SDK note reminding integrators not to transform Redwood headers.
rachel: Thanks everyone. Closing for now; reopen if canary shows anomalies.
